features.statement: Body text uses the system UI font stack rather than a custom web font.
Body copy has a larger font size and generous line height for readability.
Headings are large and bold with tight letter-spacing, including the hero headline.
Hero background is a dark navy-to-purple gradient with no photograph.
Logo is a plain text wordmark with a colored dot accent rather than an image.
Navigation links are right-aligned and all styled uniformly, with no highlighted tab.
Primary call-to-action is a fully rounded cyan pill button with sentence-case label.
Accent palette is purple and cyan, with dark navy body text.
FAQ is a stack of centered single-column bordered cards, with numbered question headings as H3.
Inline links are underlined and colored in the accent purple.
Video placeholder is a narrower rounded gradient card with a translucent white circular play button.
Text-only cards on pale blue-grey backgrounds have a colored top border and no logos or images.
Secondary 'read more' actions are bold accent-colored text links with a trailing arrow, not boxed buttons.
Logo strip images are small and uniformly sized, and every image has descriptive alt text.
Footer lists social links as plain text in a column, with copyright left and badge right above a divider.
Layout uses CSS grid and semantic section and article elements, with minimal DOM, scripts and classes.
Styling is a single embedded style block with no inline styles, shadows, animations or transforms.
Page is compact, with alternating white and pale blue-grey section bands and a shorter hero.
Typographic punctuation such as en dashes is used to join phrases in titles and subtitles.
